plans.label: (a) Pay on signature
plans.formula: Definitions shared by all plans: plan year = calendar 2026; for each rep r, frac_r = (as_of − max(2026-01-01, r.start_date)).days / 365 (proration from rep start date); Q_r = Q_annual_r × frac_r where Q_annual_r = reps.quota_funded_annual (AE 48, STRATEGIC 36; a params.quota_funded_annual override applies to all reps); credit_i = lp_milestone_credit if account i is_liquidity_partner else 1 (LPs normally sit with the Partnerships Desk, which is excluded from comp); qualifying trade = fill ≥10 contracts, non-self-match; Active = ≥4 distinct trading days in trailing 30. S = agreements signed in the period credited to r, ordered by signed_at; k = position. pay_k = unit × multipliers.signed × credit_k × (accelerator if k > Q_r else 1). variable = Σ pay_k. No clawback, no ADV kicker, accelerator not gated.
plans.behavior: Rewards signing as many agreements as possible, including marginal accounts that never fund or trade.
risks: Activation work is dumped on RevOps; signed→funded and funded→trade conversion is nobody's number.
Pays out on accounts that generate zero ADV or fees, so variable cost per Active account is the highest of the three plans.
Encourages pulling signatures forward at quarter-end regardless of KYC readiness.
At v1.1 parameters a 64-signature rep earns $150k variable whatever the book trades; in the worked example that is 50–206% of the fees their book generated.

plans.label: (b) Pay on funded
plans.formula: Definitions shared by all plans: plan year = calendar 2026; for each rep r, frac_r = (as_of − max(2026-01-01, r.start_date)).days / 365 (proration from rep start date); Q_r = Q_annual_r × frac_r where Q_annual_r = reps.quota_funded_annual (AE 48, STRATEGIC 36; a params.quota_funded_annual override applies to all reps); credit_i = lp_milestone_credit if account i is_liquidity_partner else 1 (LPs normally sit with the Partnerships Desk, which is excluded from comp); qualifying trade = fill ≥10 contracts, non-self-match; Active = ≥4 distinct trading days in trailing 30. F = accounts with funded_at in the period credited to r, ordered by funded_at; k = position. pay_k = unit × multipliers.funded × credit_k × (accelerator if k > Q_r else 1). clawback_k = clawback_pct × pay_k if no qualifying trade within clawback_days of funded_at and that window has closed by as_of. variable = Σ pay_k − Σ clawback_k. No ADV kicker; accelerator not gated.
plans.behavior: Rewards getting accounts through KYC and funded, with a light penalty when they never trade.
risks: Funded-but-dormant accounts still keep 50% of the payout; a one-lot trade avoids the clawback entirely.
No pay for ADV, so a $30/day C&I account earns the same as a 400-contract/day prop firm.
AE attention ends at first trade; habit formation (Active) is unowned.

plans.label: (c) Funded + activation + ADV (recommended)
plans.formula: Definitions shared by all plans: plan year = calendar 2026; for each rep r, frac_r = (as_of − max(2026-01-01, r.start_date)).days / 365 (proration from rep start date); Q_r = Q_annual_r × frac_r where Q_annual_r = reps.quota_funded_annual (AE 48, STRATEGIC 36; a params.quota_funded_annual override applies to all reps); credit_i = lp_milestone_credit if account i is_liquidity_partner else 1 (LPs normally sit with the Partnerships Desk, which is excluded from comp); qualifying trade = fill ≥10 contracts, non-self-match; Active = ≥4 distinct trading days in trailing 30. F = accounts with funded_at in the period credited to r, ordered by funded_at; k = position. book_activation_r = (accounts in F whose 60-day window has closed by as_of and that reached Active within 60d of funded_at) ÷ (accounts in F whose 60-day window has closed); if the denominator is 0, book_activation_r = 0. gate_r = book_activation_r ≥ accelerator_min_book_activation. a_k = accelerator if (k > Q_r AND gate_r) else 1. funded_i = unit × multipliers.funded × credit_i (never accelerated). active_i = unit × credit_i × (multipliers.active_60d × [Active within 60d of funded_at] + multipliers.active_21d_bonus × [Active within 21d of funded_at]) × a_k (accelerator applies to these Active milestones only). clawback_i = clawback_pct × funded_i if no qualifying trade within clawback_days of funded_at (window closed by as_of). Kicker: C_i = non-self-match contracts traded by i in its first 365 days after funded_at (up to as_of); E_i = C_i × (lp_kicker_credit if is_liquidity_partner else 1); base_i = min(adv_kicker_cap, adv_kicker_per_1k × E_i / 1000); E'_i = base_i / adv_kicker_per_1k × 1000; V_r = volume_target_contracts_annual × frac_r; uplift_r = (adv_kicker_accel − 1) × adv_kicker_per_1k × max(0, Σ E'_i − V_r) / 1000 (not gated). variable = Σ funded_i + Σ active_i − Σ clawback_i + Σ base_i + uplift_r. Report accelerator_applied = gate_r AND any k > Q_r with an Active milestone.
plans.behavior: Rewards fast activation of high-ADV fits: pay concentrates on funded accounts that form a weekly trading habit within 21–60 days, and the accelerator only opens once at least half the book is Active.
risks: Calibration: the derived unit ($1,250) pays the $72k account component at the 70% Active target (30% fast, 15% no-trade) on 48 funded; a rep below 50% book activation earns no accelerator however many accounts they fund.
Reps may steer toward prop/fund accounts with high ADV priors; the queue balance weight (B) and hedger-mix scorecard review counter this.
Pushed one-lot trades: mitigated because milestones require Active (≥4 days) and the clawback uses qualifying trades (≥10 contracts).
Kicker lag: volume pays over 12 months, so payout timing must be quarterly to stay motivating.
plans.unit_derivation: per_account_unit = 72000 ÷ (quota_funded_annual × 1.20) = 72000 ÷ (48 × 1.20) = 1250; 1.20 = expected milestone multiple per funded account at plan (0.5 funded + 0.70 Active ≤60d + 0.30 × 0.25 fast bonus − 0.15 × 0.5 no-trade clawback)

reporting.pct_of_fee_revenue: Per rep: payout_variable ÷ Σ fee_usd YTD (as_of) of non-self-match trades by accounts credited to that rep. Totals and comparison rows: Σ variable_cost ÷ Σ book fee_usd YTD across simulated reps (Partnerships Desk / LP accounts excluded). Reported for all three plans. Context: at $0.25/contract, a $25/1k kicker is 10% of the fee on that volume (v1's $50/1k was 20%).
reporting.variable_cost_per_active_account: Σ variable ÷ count of credited accounts that reached Active within 60d of funding.
reporting.variable_cost_per_1k_contracts: Σ variable ÷ (Σ non-self-match contracts traded YTD by credited accounts / 1000).
reporting.book_activation: As defined in the activation_adv formula. Reported per rep for every plan alongside accelerator_applied; only activation_adv gates its accelerator on it.
